column1: # Folketingsvalgene den 20. Maj 1913 med Suppleringsvalg i Tiden 1910-13 (Statistiske Meddelelser, 4. Række, 42. Bind, 3. Hæfte); constituency tables pages 20-48, by-elections page 49
# a ditto mark (") in a ballot line is written 0; the "Heraf Søfolk" rows (seamen's votes, included in the parish figures) are not transcribed
# two polling places printed: Kallundborg Købst. for the mainland parishes, Onsbjerg for Samsø
# the parish "Deraf stemte" figures add to 3000, not the printed Tilsammen 3007, which agrees with the candidates and ballot lines; the book footnotes the discrepancy (Note 7, page 16)
# misprint: 40 Randers Amt 1 candidates 2677 + invalid 14 + blank 3 = 2694, one more than the 2693 voted; the book's footnote refers to Note 7 on page 16 on discrepant reported figures

# misprint: 43 Skanderborg Amt 5 candidates 3341 + invalid 7 + blank 4 = 3352, two more than the 3350 voted (the parish figures add to 3350); the book's footnote refers to Note 7 on page 16 on discrepant reported figures

# the Faroe Islands (printed "Færø Amts Valgkreds") voted on 16 June 1913 (footnote on page 48); the single candidate is printed "Sysselmand Andreas Sumuelsen, V., Sambandsmand, Fuglefjord" (the name is spelled so; elsewhere Samuelsen), and the votes against him are printed as "Nej-Stemmer"
